assumptions.rationale: The formal boundary relies on the declared host faithfully executing qualified durability operations.
assumptions.scope: Host OS and storage behavior used by current-core and adapter obligations.

assumptions.rationale: Durability conclusions are conditional on the documented filesystem operations meeting their contracts.
assumptions.scope: Durable intent, store recovery, receipts, capture, and Linux adapter claims.

assumptions.rationale: All machine-checked conclusions depend on the pinned compiler and verifier preserving their documented meaning.
assumptions.scope: Every formal obligation and produced executable binding.

assumptions.rationale: Digest bindings assume collision and second-preimage resistance for the selected cryptographic hashes.
assumptions.scope: Basis, acknowledgement, store, evidence, and source/evidence bindings.

assumptions.rationale: Finite state exploration covers only declared bounds and does not establish an unbounded implementation proof.
assumptions.scope: Bounded ILRP recovery models and later explicitly bounded models.

assumptions.rationale: Recovery progress requires eventual availability; safety alone does not imply termination under perpetual failure.
assumptions.scope: ILRP recovery liveness and later progress properties.

assumptions.rationale: Initial durability qualification is limited to declared Linux filesystem and syscall behavior.
assumptions.scope: Current Linux durability adapters; no portability inheritance.

assumptions.rationale: Qualification binds a clean fixed source tree and does not cover hostile same-user mutation during the run.
assumptions.scope: Qualification execution environment and evidence capture.
